name: clean gate-core change goes to the panel and both approve
why: A product PR that changes tiers.mjs (the gate's own core): code marks it authority-expanding (panel). The change is exactly the asked one and loosens nothing; both reviewers must approve it.

card.reason: it changes the gate's own core (services/runner/src/tiers.mjs)
